findings.title: Cross-language neighbors: honest negative result
findings.detail: Cross-language neighbor discovery returns 0 for all tested decisions. Language dominance (0.982) means all spatially nearest neighbors are same-language. Feature works correctly; underlying representation is the constraint.
findings.impact: Users cannot discover cross-language neighbors via spatial proximity. State correctly documents this limitation.

findings.title: TF-IDF text similarity uses truncated text
findings.detail: TF-IDF model uses text truncated to 2000 chars per document. Similarity scores are lower than full-text would produce.
findings.impact: Text similarity is a rough approximation. State correctly documents this.

findings.title: Corpus summaries rebuilt per API call
findings.detail: get_cross_language_neighbors and get_text_similarity rebuild the full corpus_summaries dict on every call (O(n) for 1000+ decisions). Not cached.
findings.impact: Minor performance overhead (~10ms estimated). Not a correctness issue.

findings.title: TF-IDF shared terms reverse lookup is O(n)
findings.detail: In tfidf_proximity.py line 171, token-for-index reverse lookup iterates entire vocab dict per shared term. ~685K iterations for typical query.
findings.impact: Sub-millisecond in practice. Not a functional issue.
